node.title: DLI primitive conflict pressure is bounded by a truncated exponential
node.statement: If every primitive signed relation at a DLI level has support at least w_0, every compatible collection in the primitive independence polynomial has size at most K=floor(N/w_0). Weighted clique symmetrization gives the sharp total-activity bound I<=(1+P/K)^K<=Exp_K(P), hence E_j<=r_j(1+W_full,j/K_j)^K_j for the raw primitive ledger. The proved production exclusions give K=51 at ell=1, K=85 at ell=2, K=113 at ell=4, and K=floor(256ell/(2ell+1))<=127 for ell>=8. Therefore the full marginal baseline follows from sum_j K_j log(1+W_full,j/K_j)<=100log2+t log(2^256/q). The pressure bound is not asserted; this is the first exact support-conflict correction after the exp(W_full) route fence.
